round54ReviewAdditions.title: Purge preview identity, concurrency and partial recovery
requiredChecks: Manual confirmation binds actor, permission version, source generation, mapping, keep-set and candidate data boundary to a server preview valid for five minutes; changed or expired previews reject before deletion.

Manual, PrtgDailyPipeline and PrtgStructureSyncRunner purge paths share ownership, consistency and durable partial-progress protection; automatic runs bind successful sync generation and retain shrink guards without requiring a manual preview.

Check concurrent automatic/manual runs, duplicate confirmation, mapping changes, job-start-after-check and mid-batch failure/restart. Same accepted request returns the same operation, never a new deletion.

Recheck Maintain before acceptance and before every new batch/resume. Revocation stops at the next safe point with exact durable counts; no new batch starts. Resume requires restored authority and unchanged accepted scope/generation; otherwise require a new preview and operation with predecessor linkage.

round54ReviewAdditions.title: One analysis-date contract across disk verification
requiredChecks: Backend derives completed analysis date from saved analysis timezone; UI displays supplied date and timezone, not browser-local yesterday.
Single/batch start, eligibility, preview, evidence expiry and manual confirmation use the same date contract.
Different browser/server/analysis zones, midnight crossings and DST 23/25-hour days have exact expected UTC intervals; reject ambiguous points without silently dropping a valid completed day.

round54ReviewAdditions.title: Actionable qualification and recovery states
requiredChecks: Distinguish missing authority/configuration, insufficient samples, actionable manual review, mismatch, stale settings and retryable failure.
Maintain reaches the correct repair setting; non-Maintain sees the reason and administrator action without a dead-end forbidden link.
Repair then reverify through normal UI; admin/runs/detail/report agree on state, and manual review is offered only when usable matched points exist.

round54ReviewAdditions.title: Global destructive scope with restricted readable details
requiredChecks: Separate global impact counts, visible detail counts and permission-limited detail disclosure; zero visible detail is not zero affected data.
Confirmation explicitly says global deletion is not limited to displayed names; filter authorization before taking the visible top 20.
Test hidden names/identifiers, more than 20 devices, orphan sensors and zero-visible users; safe blocking reasons and exact authorized detail sets.

round54ReviewAdditions.title: Message-time migration and downstream lifecycle
requiredChecks: Map date-format, culture, raw/source/analysis timezone, source-generation and unrelated scope changes to each authority fingerprint and cursor.
On upgrade or authority change, unqualified message evidence cannot create new formal risk/cases/mail; retain historical facts, manual replies and valid unrelated NetIQ/raw evidence.

Pre-existing findings/cases/replies/pending mail, restart, replay, setting restore and version rollback are checked across collector, read side, reports, exports and notification consumers; blank legacy authority is never retroactively trusted.

Distinguish setting restore from binary rollback. A2 freezes the exact prior supported artifact and paired pre-upgrade DB/key/config backup. Direct downgrade against upgraded storage is denied unless same-data compatibility is proven; otherwise use paired restore. Verify cases/replies, pending jobs, notification dedupe and post-backup delta accounting without replaying already accepted mail blindly.

round54ReviewAdditions.title: Bounded-read units, failure isolation and repair
requiredChecks: Mode cap is 262144 characters and disk snapshot cap is 33554432 characters; encoded bytes and process memory are separate measured quantities, not renamed limits.
SQLite/SQL Server ASCII, Chinese, supplementary characters, cap boundaries and oversized/malformed input are tested for equivalent acceptance decisions.

Isolate by evidence dependency: a host mode blob blocks its dependent items; an unreadable/oversized shared disk blob puts every dependent disk qualification into explicit wait. Independent NetIQ, evidence and notifications continue. No partial trust of corrupt shared JSON, no new storage split/migration; bounded authorized repair preserves CAS and unrelated data.

round54ReviewAdditions.title: Executable maintenance roles and frozen round54 build
requiredChecks: Retain six baseline roles plus four real-login maintenance scenarios. M54-scoped is a synthetic authorization-component defense only, not an account, browser acceptance or production role. No authorization-model expansion; actual rescue login remains distinct.
Freeze current round54 source commit, Web/Core/static assets, fixture and environment identities; old results are reused only with explicit unchanged-scope evidence.
Later extend validators/fixture/recorders to check supplementary roles and review IDs; current document additions alone do not provision roles or claim browser acceptance.

round54ReviewAdditions.title: Traceable substage completion and repair loop
requiredChecks: Each F/G substage has original IDs, dependencies, exact expected results, negative cases and accessible evidence; original TODO closes only after all linked mandatory items pass.
The 27 TODOs and 53 inherited gaps are baseline counts, not a ceiling; eight review additions remain separately pending and new findings are recorded explicitly.
Before each stage acceptance and final acceptance, inspect real consumers and repair omissions; only rerun affected evidence unless changes invalidate broader results.

coverageCounting.rule: Review items contain multiple required checks and are not interchangeable units of completion. All remain pending; inherited evidence does not close new checks.

round54ContractCorrections.required: Four real-login maintenance scenarios plus one synthetic component defense; no new role or authorization expansion.
Evidence-dependency isolation; unreadable shared disk evidence blocks dependent disk qualification, not independent work; no storage redesign.
Manual and both automatic purge entry points share safety and durable partial recovery; preserve automatic scope/shrink guards.
Freeze exact rollback target and backup set before upgrade; reject unproven direct same-data downgrade; account for later replies/jobs/mail.
Five-minute preview, exact invalidators, idempotent confirmation, permission revocation and safe resume/new-operation distinction.

round54ExecutionRefinements.title: Parent-child purge ownership
checks: Automatic purge inherits a verified parent operation identity from daily sync, standalone sync or sync inside backfill; do not reject a valid child merely because its own parent is running.
Only that parent may delegate the child step; competing external operations remain excluded. Parent cancellation or loss of ownership stops the child at a safe point.
Verify daily-sync-to-purge and backfill-sync-to-purge success, competing manual/automatic rejection, cancellation and no self-wait or ownership leak.

round54ExecutionRefinements.title: Live authority per batch
checks: Persist actor identity; before new batches/resume resolve current account state and capabilities through the existing authorization rules, not captured HTTP principal/claims.

Disable user, remove Admin and disable group without another request from the actor; no subsequent batch may start. For supported multi-process operation verify durable permission changes across processes, not process-local version cache only.
Keep Core free of duplicated role rules. Test serverAdmin configuration/restart withdrawal separately and reject stale resume; log the stopping reason and exact partial result.

round54ExecutionRefinements.title: Deletion and durable progress consistency
checks: Each committed deletion batch and progress/result evidence are atomically consistent or have a proven equivalent recovery protocol; memory-only totals are insufficient.

Inject failure before commit, after deletion commit before response/progress observation, and before result delivery; restart/retry resolves the same operation without lost or double-counted progress or inclusion of new data.
Distinguish rows removed by this operation from rows removed by retention/other legitimate work; verify accepted, deleted, otherwise-removed and remaining sets exactly on both providers.

round54ExecutionRefinements.title: Rollback pre-start gate
checks: A2 specifies and later delivers an executable rollback controller/tool with a pre-start compatibility gate; it owns rejection, not an assumption that old binaries understand new authority.

Before restored Web or background workers start, isolate schedules, source writes and notification dispatch. Keep the gate closed until exact artifact/DB/key/config, post-backup deltas and notification dedupe are verified; failure never releases isolation.

B2 tests time-authority rollback with queued mail/jobs and replies; G3 and H recheck final artifacts including F2 purge state. No external side effects occur before gate release; unproven same-data downgrade is rejected.
